dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge features a deep, irregular re-entrant notch near the midpoint, creating a jagged, non-continuous spline trajectory towards the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse shape classification; boundary pixels exhibit irregular indentation rather than a smooth curve.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 32-degree angle of ascent relative to the horizontal longitudinal axis of the body.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width to vertical height ratio is approximately 1.75:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch on the trailing edge of the dorsal fin. Pervasive white and light-grey mottled scarring across the entire dorsal fin surface and the visible back. A distinct vertical linear indentation is visible on the anterior-most portion of the dorsal body.
other_distinctive_markers: Complex, high-contrast depigmented patterning (marbling) covering 100% of the visible dorsal fin surface.
